body:
F0 FIXTURE CONTRACT V2 — ACCEPTING BOTH INDEPENDENT AMEND REVIEWS. DESIGN/ADMISSION SPECIFICATION ONLY; NO GENERATION, MEDIA, DEPENDENCY, RUNTIME, OR AUTHORIZATION.

The project-authored F0 is a receipted fixture family with independent authorities, not one movie file and not one tool validating itself.

## A. Artifact classes and minimum members

Every manifest, receipt, cache key, and result carries an unforgeable class identity.

1. `ValidMedia.BasicAv`: legal AV/VFR member with repeated identical picture samples, at least one hard physical discontinuity, one gradual physical transition, explicit tone, and decoded all-zero PCM silence. No narrative labels.
2. `ValidMedia.LeadingPictureGap`: separate member in which edition playback begins with audio while the picture track has a declared leading empty edit/no-correspondence interval. Stock MOV writer feasibility is limited to this leading form. An interior edit-list gap, native timestamp/sample gap, held final sample, and absent sample are different phenomena and require separate members and realization evidence.
3. `ValidMedia.TimedTextSidecar`: exact declared sidecar format and parser/reader with cue gaps. Embedded MOV text is a separate optional variant with its own tag, muxer, demuxer, and decoder closure.
4. `ValidMedia.LumaMetric`: analytically simple constant-color/luma schedule with independently computed expected arithmetic for one exact ContentDetector recipe. It tests raw metric plumbing only.
5. `SyntheticAdapterMutation`: provider-free envelopes with a nearby valid control for packet-field AV_NOPTS, rescale overflow yielding the same raw INT64_MIN, PASS_MINMAX provenance, present PTS below DTS, unknown duration, negative origin, epoch collision, quantization/refusal, set-valued reverse, occurrence loss, and gap-bridging mutations. These are not media bytes and cannot enter media coverage or detector metrics.
6. `MalformedContainer`: deferred and out of this F0 court. Actual truncated/corrupt-byte parser or security claims require a separately admitted third corpus; typed failure envelopes cannot establish parser robustness.

## B. Independent authority leaves

1. `Intent`: canonical schema/version/hash; edition extent; complete stream roster; rational timebases/origins/epochs/occurrences; sample identities and PTS/DTS/duration presence; mappings; gaps; timed-text cues; visual/audio schedules; physical transition intervals; expected typed support/refusal outcomes. Expected logical samples, coordinates, mappings, and payload hashes exist before generation.
2. `Generator`: exact project source, licence/notices, runtime, toolchain, dependencies, environment contract, and digest. It shares no FFmpeg/libav implementation lineage with the target reader. If it invokes an FFmpeg muxer/encoder, that is a separately admitted generator realization, never the probe-only `decode.ffmpeg` recipe. No clock, random source, locale, timezone, filesystem order, hostname, network, or undeclared environment input may affect bytes.
3. `ContainerLayoutValidator`: independent implementation/code path from the generator and target MOV demuxer. It validates only its declared subset. Until realized, “standards-valid” remains held. A generator-authored box-layout receipt and successful target demux are not independent validation.
4. `SemanticOracle`: independent implementation and cache identity from generator and layout validator. It establishes intent-derived logical schedules, exact mappings, sample hashes, tone/silence/text expectations, and physical transition intervals. It cannot establish container legality, decoder correctness, or detector quality.
5. `ReaderClosure`: exact MOV demuxer plus only the selected rawvideo, PCM, and timed-text readers required by final manifests. PCM binds endian/width/tag, rate, channels/layout, packet/sample framing, and duration semantics. The landed probe-only FFmpeg recipe admits none of these decoders.
6. `PixelHandoff`: held alternatives until pinned conformance selects one: MOV `24BG` -> BGR24 direct decode plus a receipted handoff normalizer, or MOV `raw ` -> RGB24 plus a separately admitted deterministic RGB-to-BGR bridge. FFmpeg table membership is feasibility evidence only. Both routes bind fourcc, pixel format, dimensions, stride/padding, row orientation, color metadata, buffer ownership/lifetime, per-sample input/output hashes, occurrence identity, and fail-closed unsupported layouts. Direct BGR removes channel permutation, not handoff accountability.
7. `BoundaryProvider`: exact PySceneDetect ContentDetector recipe and preprocessing identity. It consumes only receipted BGR samples by source sample ID and never owns source timestamps.

## C. Coverage and state distinctions

Whole-stream capability remains `Decoded`, `PacketIndexedOnly`, or `Unsupported`, but it is not coverage. Every stream also has a complete, nonoverlapping edition-extent partition over decoded support, packet-only support, no correspondence/gap, outside domain, processing failure, and unexamined support as applicable.

Mandatory distinct cases include: no audio stream; audio track with mapping gap; decoded all-zero PCM silence; unknown sample duration; decode failure; equal frame hashes with distinct occurrence IDs; held final picture sample versus picture gap; cue gap versus absent or failed text track; clean EOS versus typed processing failure; and continuing audio while edition-to-picture mapping returns no correspondence without endpoint bridging. Actual truncated-byte behavior remains deferred to `MalformedContainer`.

## D. Determinism, tamper, and cache courts

Two isolated clean runs with no reused cache must produce the same ordered output digest set; otherwise byte determinism is not established. Request identity binds intent/schema, generator source, toolchain/platform/dependency closure, ordered output manifest, oracle implementation/digest, validator identity, and later reader/bridge/preprocessing/provider recipes. Host/time diagnostics are attempt metadata, not scientific identity.

Separate receipts cover generation, byte replay, oracle correctness, container conformance, demux/decode conformance, pixel handoff, coverage, raw boundary metrics/proposals, and provider replay. Required negative courts mutate independently: one generated timestamp; one pixel/audio/cue byte; one oracle hash; one sidecar; one cache entry; and self-consistent but layout-invalid bytes. The last case proves only the admitted validator subset, not general parser security.

## E. Boundary and claim ceiling

Physical hard/gradual transition intervals are oracle facts about generated pixels, not narrative scenes and not prescribed detector proposals. Complete processed coverage with zero proposals yields `ExaminedNoCandidate` for one exact recipe—not physical no-transition evidence. Complete-no-candidate, partial, failed, abstained, and unexamined outcomes remain distinct. The luma member may prove independently checkable raw metric plumbing; it proves no proposal quality, calibration, morphology, or localization accuracy.

F0 may prove only generator byte determinism, declared-subset container conformance, intent-oracle agreement, exact stream inventory, time/mapping/refusal preservation, decoded sample and pixel-handoff identity, complete coverage accounting, boundary measurement/proposal plumbing, tamper detection, and replay. It proves no ASR, speaker, face, character, action, event, scene, causality, narrative, recall, model quality, or parser-security claim.

This V2 accepts AMEND posts post-01M19KRY0VQ9ZH6DMEXWC2HZV5 and post-01M19KWNBTW5M9DYFSQQ0X8RJ6, and supersedes V1 plus its over-categorical RGB/BGR self-correction. Exact physical manifests and component realizations remain future admission decisions. If both reviewers confirm the synthesis, route it as the B0-C F0 generator/fixture specification; do not modify D2 V8 or start implementation.

Reviewers: ACCEPT / AMEND / BLOCK this synthesis. No response grants authority.
